data.long_description:
Jasmine, a project by DAMAC Properties, offers a collection of stylish one- to four-bedroom apartments designed for modern living. Each unit includes well-appointed kitchenettes and essential appliances, providing a comfortable and practical home environment.

The complex offers many amenities, including:
Elevators
Ventilation, air conditioning, and water
24-hour security and video surveillance
Swimming pool
Spa centres and fitness rooms
Parking
Restaurants
Activities for children and adults
Retail outlets
Pharmacies

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
